capabilities: Save a single article from a pasted URL as Markdown
Fetch a public account's accessible history directory via the logged-in desktop WeChat client
Fetch and paginate a native WeChat album/合集 directory
Select articles by title search and download images into the vault
Keep per-account indexes, progress records, and resumable unfinished selections
extras: The plugin interface is in Chinese only. Mac WeChat 4.x history enumeration is explicitly experimental and unverified; full history also requires reading WeChat web caches outside the vault. Windows WeChat 4.1.6.14 is the only tested version for history. Requires Obsidian 1.8.0+; Linux and mobile are unsupported.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to archive WeChat Official Account articles, including their images and directory listings, as local Markdown notes.
summary: WeChat article importer that saves public-account articles as Markdown with locally downloaded images, by single URL, account history, or native album.
